description: Use this when you need the custom domains on the signed-in account, including DNS status. Read-only; requires auth; no inputs. Returns {object:"list", data:[{id, domain, status, status_detail, mail, records, dns}]}. Each record has status valid, missing, or invalid and found from the last check. Domain verification only for now; inboxes on your own domain are not available yet. Failure codes: unauthorized.
name: cooper_list_domains
title: List custom domains
